schema.description: Where the ontology registry, glossary and ontology_lookup() live: 'schema' (foundation catalog) or 'catalog.schema'. Must not be a foundation layer schema.

taxonomy.description: YAML file (relative to maya.yaml) with 'domains' (and optionally 'glossary'); see $defs/taxonomy

layers.description: Foundation layers whose assets are placed on pages

metric_view_schemas.description: Schemas whose metric views are placed on pages (default: the G2 schema)

exclude.description: Assets left off the semantic model: names, 'schema.name' or globs

tag_keys.description: Tag keys (default: <project>_domain, <project>_subdomain, <project>_page). Governed tags are account-wide, so the defaults are per project.

governed_tags.description: Create the tag keys as governed tags whose allowed values are the taxonomy ids

glossary_from_metric_views.description: Every metric-view measure becomes a glossary term (its display name, description and synonyms)

min_confidence.description: Agent placements below this confidence are reported for review

mode.description: incremental keeps certified agent-built pages and placements; full designs them again

id.description: Controlled tag value: lower case, digits, underscores

pages.description: 'auto' (agents design the pages) or a list of pages; a page may be partial (only a name, or some assets)

allow_new_pages.description: With a page list: agents may add pages for assets that fit none of the listed ones

description.description: Missing: written by the page designer agent

assets.description: Assets placed on this page ('schema.name' or 'catalog.schema.name'); the rest are placed by agents

links.description: Objects ('schema.name') or fields ('schema.name.column' / 'schema.metric_view.measure') implementing the term
